title: Remnants in Depth
idiom: Haeckel scientific engraving meets Japanese woodblock print
hero_prompt: Wide darkened scene rendered as a high-contrast ink engraving: a cluster of ink blobs and splatter marks at varying depths receding into a cinematic interior, each mark a flat hand-drawn disc hovering in space — near marks large and sharp, far marks small and faint — connected by faint vector-field flow lines that curve and streak the marks along their direction. Chiaroscuro lighting, Haeckel crosshatch texture, woodblock-print flatness. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem in two-value ink: a single large ink splatter blob at center, its shadow a smaller blob offset behind it in grey — suggesting depth through the billboard trick, nothing else. Hard edge, survives 24px, no fine linework, no text, no letters, no numerals.
